PROXY_RECOVERY_BUSY: Another Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool process is changing the Windows proxy settings. Wait a moment and try again.
PROXY_RECOVERY_OTHER_INSTANCE: Another running Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool is capturing this PC. Stop that capture before starting this one.

PROXY_RECOVERY_NOT_APPLIED_UNRESTORED: The Windows proxy settings did not read back as written to capture this PC, and Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool could not complete proxy recovery or cleanup; your previous settings may already be restored. The listener was kept available in case Windows still uses this tool's proxy ({0}). Stop capture to retry recovery; it is also retried when Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool closes and when it next starts.
PROXY_RECOVERY_NOT_APPLIED_CLEANUP: The Windows proxy settings did not read back as written to capture this PC, so this PC is not captured. Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool could not complete proxy recovery or cleanup; your previous settings may already be restored. It tries again when it closes and when it next starts.
PROXY_RECOVERY_SETTINGS_UNREADABLE: Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool could not read the Windows proxy settings, so it did not set them to capture this PC. Windows may already use this tool's proxy ({0}), so the listener was kept available. Stop capture to turn that proxy off once the settings can be read.
PROXY_RECOVERY_UNRESTORED: Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool could not complete proxy recovery or cleanup; your previous Windows proxy settings may already be restored. It tries again when you start or stop a capture and when it next starts. If Windows still uses this tool's proxy ({0}), turn off the proxy in the Windows proxy settings.
PROXY_RECOVERY_DISABLE_FOREIGN: The Windows proxy is set to {0}, which is not the proxy of this capture, so it was left as it is. Turn it off in the Windows proxy settings if you do not need it.
PROXY_RECOVERY_DISABLE_FAILED: Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool could not complete turning off the Windows proxy; it may already be off. If Windows still uses this tool's proxy ({0}), turn off the proxy in the Windows proxy settings.
PROXY_RECOVERY_DISABLE_FAILED_UNKNOWN: Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool could not complete turning off the Windows proxy; it may already be off.
PROXY_RECOVERY_GUARD_FAILED: The helper that restores your Windows proxy settings if Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool closes unexpectedly did not start, so the Windows proxy was not changed.
PROXY_RECOVERY_JOB_REFUSED: Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool is running in a process group that could end its proxy recovery helper together with it, as some terminals and tools do. The Windows proxy was not changed. Start Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool directly to capture this PC.
PROXY_RECOVERY_GUARD_LOST: The helper that protects your Windows proxy settings stopped unexpectedly. Your Windows proxy settings are back to what they were before the capture, so this PC's traffic is no longer captured. Stop, then start capture to resume.
PROXY_RECOVERY_GUARD_LOST_CHANGED: The helper that protects your Windows proxy settings stopped unexpectedly. Your Windows proxy settings were changed during the capture, so they were left as they are. Stop, then start capture to resume capturing this PC.
PROXY_RECOVERY_GUARD_LOST_UNRESTORED: The helper that protects your Windows proxy settings stopped unexpectedly, and Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool could not complete proxy recovery or cleanup; your previous settings may already be restored. Stop capture to retry recovery. It is also retried when Xbox Multiplayer Analysis Tool closes and when it next starts.

HOST_LISTS_WINDOW_INTRO: These Block and Bypass lists are shared by every capture in this session; any change, including Clear All, applies to new requests and connections in every capture immediately. Block stops matching requests and wins when a host is in both lists. The lists are cleared when XMAT exits.
HOST_LISTS_SCOPE: These lists are shared by every capture in this session, so changes here, including Clear All, apply to every capture. They are not saved when XMAT exits.
HOST_LIST_PATTERN_HELP: A host entry applies to every port and does not include subdomains, so do not add a port (such as example.com:443). In a pattern that contains * or a path, text such as :8080 is matched literally and is not a port filter. Write IPv6 addresses in patterns without brackets, such as 2001:db8::* or ::1/api/*; an IPv6 pattern with brackets never matches.
HOST_LIST_BYPASS_TIMING: Bypass skips HTTPS decryption for new connections only; connections that are already open keep their current mode. This is not the Windows proxy bypass list.
HOST_LIST_PORT_NOT_ALLOWED: "{0}" includes a port. Host list entries apply to every port, so enter the host without the port.
HOST_LIST_ADD_BYPASS: Add "{0}" to Bypass List (HTTPS decryption bypass, new connections only)
HOST_LIST_REMOVE_BYPASS: Remove "{0}" from Bypass List (new connections only)
HOST_LIST_BLOCK_WINS: Block wins for new connections; bypassed connections that are already open continue until they close.
HOST_LIST_NO_HOST: No host is available for this item
HOST_LIST_NO_PHYSICAL_HOST: No single captured host for this endpoint (synthesized, combined or older data)
